manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Generates a complete digital estate from an intent — org tree, factory agent stubs, souls, HTML dashboard — via brainstem or LLM APIs when available.

args.intent: I want an estate that produces a daily blog post and a weekly podcast script.

manifest.name: @kody-w/estate_factory

intent.description: What the user wants the estate to do. Required for design + generate.

name.description: Slug for the estate. Required for generate/provision/tour.

type.description: Estate type 1-5. Optional; inferred from intent if omitted.

write_souls.description: On generate, also call the SoulWriter persona to produce real soul prompts (slower; cheap mode skips this and uses placeholders).
